stories.title: Banks to remain open on Sunday for customers’ convenience in view of proposed nationwide strike

en.title: Banks to remain open on Sunday for customers' convenience in view of proposed nationwide strike
en.summary: Banks will open on Sunday to serve customers ahead of a planned three-day strike by the United Forum of Bank Unions starting September 28, which is demanding a five-day banking week among other demands.

stories.title: "Unanimous Decisions Of Full Commission": Election Body On 'Dissent' Report

en.title: "Unanimous Decisions Of Full Commission": Election Body On 'Dissent' Report
en.summary: The Election Commission of India addressed a report regarding internal dissent by emphasizing that its decisions are made unanimously by all three top officers.

stories.title: IIT Bombay Professor Suryanarayana Doolla sent on leave for impartial probe into student’s death

en.title: IIT Bombay Professor Suryanarayana Doolla sent on leave for impartial probe into student's death
en.summary: An IIT Bombay professor has been placed on leave pending an investigation into a student's death, following his removal as dean and subsequent protests on campus.

stories.title: Differing views, observations are normal part of deliberation in any institution: ECI on reports of internal friction

en.title: Differing views, observations are normal part of deliberation in any institution: ECI on reports of internal friction
en.summary: The Election Commission of India stated that differing perspectives during internal discussions are normal, noting that selective highlighting of certain observations misrepresents the broader range of approvals and decisions made.

stories.title: Deep depression to cross Andhra-Odisha coast near Kalingapatnam tonight; red alert in five Andhra districts

en.title: Deep depression to cross Andhra-Odisha coast near Kalingapatnam tonight; red alert in five Andhra districts
en.summary: A deep depression is expected to cross the Andhra-Odisha coast near Kalingapatnam. Red alerts have been issued for five Andhra districts through Thursday morning, with schools closed in the affected region.

stories.title: ‘Vote chori’ direct attack on Constitution; BJP, RSS, EC committed act of treason: Rahul Gandhi

en.title: 'Vote chori' direct attack on Constitution; BJP, RSS, EC committed act of treason: Rahul Gandhi
en.summary: Rahul Gandhi, the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha, criticized alleged electoral irregularities as a constitutional violation and accused the BJP, RSS, and Election Commission of treasonous acts.

stories.title: "Differing Views Part Of Deliberation": Election Commission's Full Statement Amid Row

en.title: "Differing Views Part Of Deliberation": Election Commission's Full Statement Amid Row
en.summary: The Election Commission issued a statement addressing internal disagreements, characterizing differing views as a normal part of the deliberation process.

stories.title: 'Differing views normal part of deliberation': EC responds after report flags rift over SIR

en.title: 'Differing views normal part of deliberation': EC responds after report flags rift over SIR
en.summary: The Election Commission stated that differing opinions among members during the Special Intensive Revision are standard in decision-making, with all final decisions made unanimously. Opposition leaders have alleged the process targets specific voter groups favoring the BJP.

stories.title: PSU banks to remain open on Sunday ahead of 3-day strike from September 28

en.title: PSU banks to remain open on Sunday ahead of 3-day strike from September 28
en.summary: Public sector banks will operate on Sunday before a planned 3-day strike commencing September 28.

stories.title: After Teen's Gangrape, Delhi Lt Governor Orders Safety Audit Of All Parks

en.title: After Teen's Gangrape, Delhi Lt Governor Orders Safety Audit Of All Parks
en.summary: Following a sexual assault case, Delhi's Lt Governor has instructed a comprehensive safety review of all public parks. Three suspects have been taken into custody.

en.title: 'Invisible Hand, Vote Chori': Congress Leads Attack On Poll Body After 'Dissent' Report
en.summary: The Congress party, led by Rahul Gandhi, has launched criticism against the election authority following a report indicating internal disagreement.

stories.title: 'This is treason': Rahul revives 'vote chori' charge after report of rift within EC

en.title: 'This is treason': Rahul revives 'vote chori' charge after report of rift within EC
en.summary: Rahul Gandhi has accused the Election Commission of serious misconduct in connection with electoral processes, while the Commission denies any internal divisions and confirms collective decision-making.

stories.title: SS Retail shares rally another 6% after bumper listing at 51% premium over IPO price. Buy, sell or hold?

en.title: SS Retail shares rally another 6% after bumper listing at 51% premium over IPO price. Buy, sell or hold?
en.summary: SS Retail shares gained over 6% following a strong listing with a 50.73% premium to the IPO price. The stock trades at elevated valuations with limited margin of safety despite solid growth prospects, prompting a neutral recommendation.

stories.title: Hero Motors shares hit 20% upper circuit after lackluster debut. Should you buy, sell or hold?

en.title: Hero Motors shares hit 20% upper circuit after lackluster debut. Should you buy, sell or hold?
en.summary: Hero Motors shares recovered sharply with a 20% gain to the upper circuit after listing with a 2% discount. Analysts recommend holding existing positions with stop-losses or awaiting price consolidation before new investments.

stories.title: Meesho shares drop 4% after block deal worth Rs 900 crore. Should you buy the dip?

en.title: Meesho shares drop 4% after block deal worth Rs 900 crore. Should you buy the dip?
en.summary: Meesho shares declined 4% after a block deal involving 3.86 crore shares worth approximately Rs 900 crore occurred on the exchange. The dip followed a recent 10% rally triggered by an analyst price target increase.

stories.title: Clean Max shares surge 13% in 3 days as Macquarie initiates coverage with outperform rating

en.title: Clean Max shares surge 13% in 3 days as Macquarie initiates coverage with outperform rating
en.summary: Clean Max shares gained 13% over three days after Macquarie began coverage with an outperform rating and a target price implying 24% additional upside. Macquarie is the second brokerage to initiate coverage on the stock.

stories.title: Sensex jumps 350 points, Nifty above 23,400 as oil dips below $99/barrel. What can trigger the next sharp rally on D-Street?

en.title: Sensex jumps 350 points, Nifty above 23,400 as oil dips below $99/barrel. What can trigger the next sharp rally on D-Street?
en.summary: Indian benchmark indices gained up to 0.5% with support from metal and financial stocks. Crude prices and bond yields remain limiting factors, while midcap and smallcap valuations show signs of overextension according to analysts.
